index.title: PrivyJobs — buy workflows, channels & data, not models
index.hero.h1: Buy how someone works — not another model
index.hero.en: PrivyJobs — sell workflows, channels & data, not the model
index.hero.lede: Sellers list real pipelines, private channels, and datasets; buyers order that practice. The platform matches for free and hosts clarify threads; pay via WeChat / Alipay off-platform — no fund custody. Not a model marketplace or LLM wrapper.
index.demo_rules: Demo rules: close if undelivered 7 days after lock; one rework then close. Toggle buyer/seller in the header; Guided demo walks post → one clarify lock → result package → accept.
index.agent_note: Buyer AI draft: Agent API (mock JSON) — create_job / clarify / accept. Selling something? Pre-register (free match · off-platform settle · no full KB upload · not live matching).
index.what.w1.p: Steps already running: clean rules, maps, review checklists. You buy reusable practice, not a model improvising.
index.what.w2.p: Clarify and delivery stay between the two parties. No public Q&A; finished work is not a forum post.
index.what.w3.p: Synonym tables, alias masters, redacted samples — assets from the seller’s environment, licensed per order.
index.what.w4.p: We don’t host weights or rank parameters. Compute stays on each side; we match who has which practice and data.
index.how.s1.p: Buyer writes capability bounds and accept criteria. The platform only logs intent and status — no freeze, no money handling.
index.how.s2.p: Match on registered workflow / data domains. Full catalogs stay private; unmatched jobs can’t be taken.
index.how.s3.p: Seller asks one round within pipeline bounds; buyer only answers the list — no KB fishing. After lock: “Brief locked · seller stops open Q&A, in production”.
index.how.s4.p: Seller submits a result package (summary / artifacts / accept check). After accept, parties settle via WeChat/Alipay. No custody, no platform payout.
index.why.w1.p: Clarify stays inside the order. Public pages show finished samples of delivery shape — not a discussion board.
index.why.w2.h: Skills are declarations, not tag walls
index.why.w2.p: Sellers state sellable workflow/data bounds at register; we match on that. Outsiders never see the full catalog.
index.why.w3.p: We don’t run your model or host your weights. Artifacts may transit the platform; the pipeline stays local.
index.why.w4.h: Off-platform pay — we don’t touch money
index.why.w4.p: Early phase is free matching; orders live on-platform; pay via WeChat/Alipay. Reputation points are optional — not fiat, not order currency.
index.show.lede: Showcase shows delivery shape. Invoice normalizer includes downloadable real small files; others are tone-true demo excerpts.
points.title: Reputation & activity — PrivyJobs
points.lede: Early “points” are demo reputation / activity garnish — not fiat, and not order currency. The platform does free matching and order logs; parties settle via WeChat / Alipay off-platform; no fund custody.
points.rules: Demo rules: close intent if undelivered 7 days after lock; one rework then close. Accept buttons only update status — not custody or payout.
points.settle.1.p: Buyer writes bounds and accept criteria; the site keeps an order log. Optional reference points are demo reputation only — no funds locked.
points.settle.2.p: Seller clarifies bounds in private chat; after lock, production starts. Still no money through the platform.
points.settle.3.p: Delivery reaches the buyer on the private channel. Accept / rework only changes order status — no custody.
points.settle.4.p: After agree-to-accept, pay via WeChat / Alipay yourselves. The platform does not custody funds. Reputation may light up optionally.
points.note: This static site has no real accounts. Demo ledger lives in localStorage to exercise the state machine. Product boundary: free match + off-platform settle; points ≠ money.
points.role.seller: Role: seller — watch reputation after accept; pay off-platform.
points.role.buyer: Role: buyer — watch demo reference points and intent log; pay off-platform.
points.ledger_empty: No ledger yet. Post or act on an order to see rows.

orders.title: Orders — PrivyJobs
orders.lede: Local intent / order log. Toggle buyer / seller: seller locks after one clarify round; delivery needs a result package. Buyer answers the question list (no KB fishing), then accepts. Accept only updates status; pay off-platform (WeChat / Alipay). No fund custody.
orders.pool.help: Visible as seller: clarify-status jobs with no resident yet. “Claim to try” binds a local identity, then clarify. Buyer never sees the seller directory.
